entries.title: Numbers 15:1
segments: ¶And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 15:2
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: 'When you have come into the land you are to inhabit, which I am giving to you,

entries.title: Numbers 15:3
segments: 'and you make an offering by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a vow or as a freewill offering or in your appointed feasts, to make a sweet aroma to the LORD, from the herd or the flock,

entries.title: Numbers 15:4
segments: 'then he who presents his offering to the LORD shall bring a grain offering of one-tenth [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with one-fourth of a hin of oil;

entries.title: Numbers 15:5
segments: 'and one-fourth of a hin of wine as a drink offering you shall prepare with the burnt offering or the sacrifice, for each lamb.

entries.title: Numbers 15:6
segments: 'Or for a ram you shall prepare as a grain offering two-tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with one-third of a hin of oil;

entries.title: Numbers 15:7
segments: 'and as a drink offering you shall offer one-third of a hin of wine as a sweet aroma to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 15:8
segments: 'And when you prepare a young bull as a burnt offering, or as a sacrifice to fulfill a vow, or as a peace offering to the LORD,

entries.title: Numbers 15:9
segments: 'then shall be offered with the young bull a grain offering of three-tenths [of an ephah] of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

entries.title: Numbers 15:10
segments: 'and you shall bring as the drink offering half a hin of wine as an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 15:11
segments: 'Thus it shall be done for each young bull, for each ram, or for each lamb or young goat.

entries.title: Numbers 15:12
segments: 'According to the number that you prepare, so you shall do with everyone according to their number.

entries.title: Numbers 15:13
segments: 'All who are native-born shall do these things in this manner, in presenting an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 15:14
segments: 'And if a stranger dwells with you, or whoever [is] among you throughout your generations, and would present an offering made by fire, a sweet aroma to the LORD, just as you do, so shall he do.

entries.title: Numbers 15:15
segments: 'One ordinance [shall be] for you of the assembly and for the stranger who dwells [with you], an ordinance forever throughout your generations; as you are, so shall the stranger be before the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 15:16
segments: 'One law and one custom shall be for you and for the stranger who dwells with you.'"

entries.title: Numbers 15:17
segments: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 15:18
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them: 'When you come into the land to which I bring you,

entries.title: Numbers 15:19
segments: 'then it will be, when you eat of the bread of the land, that you shall offer up a heave offering to the LORD.

entries.title: Numbers 15:20
segments: 'You shall offer up a cake of the first of your ground meal [as] a heave offering; as a heave offering of the threshing floor, so shall you offer it up.

entries.title: Numbers 15:21
segments: 'Of the first of your ground meal you shall give to the LORD a heave offering throughout your generations.

entries.title: Numbers 15:22
segments: ¶'If you sin unintentionally, and do not observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses-

entries.title: Numbers 15:23
segments: 'all that the LORD has commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations-

entries.title: Numbers 15:24
segments: 'then it will be, if it is unintentionally committed, without the knowledge of the congregation, that the whole congregation shall offer one young bull as a burnt offering, as a sweet aroma to the LORD, with its grain offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one kid of the goats as a sin offering.

entries.title: Numbers 15:25
segments: 'So the priest shall make atonement for the whole congregation of the children of Israel, and it shall be forgiven them, for it was unintentional; they shall bring their offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their unintended sin.

entries.title: Numbers 15:26
segments: 'It shall be forgiven the whole congregation of the children of Israel and the stranger who dwells among them, because all the people [did it] unintentionally.

entries.title: Numbers 15:27
segments: 'And if a person sins unintentionally, then he shall bring a female goat in its first year as a sin offering.

entries.title: Numbers 15:28
segments: 'So the priest shall make atonement for the person who sins unintentionally, when he sins unintentionally before the LORD, to make atonement for him; and it shall be forgiven him.

entries.title: Numbers 15:29
segments: 'You shall have one law for him who sins unintentionally, [for] him who is native-born among the children of Israel and for the stranger who dwells among them.

entries.title: Numbers 15:30
segments: ¶'But the person who does [anything] presumptuously, [whether he is] native-born or a stranger, that one brings reproach on the LORD, and he shall be cut off from among his people.

entries.title: Numbers 15:31
segments: 'Because he has despised the word of the LORD, and has broken His commandment, that person shall be completely cut off; his guilt [shall be] upon him.'"

entries.title: Numbers 15:32
segments: Now while the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

entries.title: Numbers 15:33
segments: And those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

entries.title: Numbers 15:34
segments: They put him under guard, because it had not been explained what should be done to him.

entries.title: Numbers 15:35
segments: Then the LORD said to Moses, "The man must surely be put to death; all the congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp."

entries.title: Numbers 15:36
segments: So, as the LORD commanded Moses, all the congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him with stones, and he died.

entries.title: Numbers 15:37
segments: ¶Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 15:38
segments: "Speak to the children of Israel: Tell them to make tassels on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and to put a blue thread in the tassels of the corners.

entries.title: Numbers 15:39
segments: "And you shall have the tassel, that you may look upon it and remember all the commandments of the LORD and do them, and that you [may] not follow the harlotry to which your own heart and your own eyes are inclined,

entries.title: Numbers 15:40
segments: "and that you may remember and do all My commandments, and be holy for your God.

entries.title: Numbers 15:41
segments: "I [am] the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I [am] the LORD your God."
